target_classes.D: external gate unavailable in this repository

probes.required_capability: A standard package and host can declare, create, persist, reconnect, and authorize 2 through 6 player seats without a hard four-player ceiling.
probes.probe_type: schema plus 2/3/4/5/6-seat lifecycle and Creator round-trip
minimum_evidence: create/join/save/reload/reconnect traces for every supported count
probes.success_condition: All five player counts complete through the standard third-party-compatible path.
probes.failure_condition: Any hard cap below six, lost seat identity, or stripped declaration.

probes.required_capability: After one death, the host provides a private tethered deceased projection and strict action whitelist while rejecting living chat and out-of-range actions.
probes.probe_type: role transition, private projection, whitelist, and leakage integration
probes.success_condition: The dead seat remains active only through its declared view/action contract with no cross-seat leak.
probes.failure_condition: Only generic spectator mode exists or tether/whitelist/privacy cannot be enforced.

probes.required_capability: A multi-step in-world action contract accepts exact terminal intent without a final popup and rejects discussion, hypotheses, and observation.
probes.probe_type: recorded intent corpus plus host UI/action-policy integration
probes.success_condition: Only exact authorized world action reaches the terminal effect.
probes.failure_condition: Ambiguous language triggers or host mandates an incompatible popup.

probes.required_capability: Platform safety/legal warnings stay distinct from puzzle signals while anomaly entry and campaign termination remain conspicuously warned in-world.
probes.probe_type: warning taxonomy and rendered action contract
probes.success_condition: Safety warnings render without turning every risk into a puzzle hint.
probes.failure_condition: Host reveals hidden answers or suppresses mandatory warnings.

probes.required_capability: Long campaigns support stable-boundary saves, package/content version locks, reload without reroll, and multi-session replay.
probes.probe_type: save/reload/version-lock/replay endurance with accelerated event volume
probes.success_condition: Long-campaign state reloads identically without package or answer drift.
probes.failure_condition: Duration/size limit, version drift, answer reroll, or unsupported campaign lifecycle.

probes.required_capability: A lineage/account true-ending unlock can be declared without inheriting answers, rules, costs, anchors, anomalies, or key-item state.
probes.success_condition: Only an opaque bounded unlock flag crosses campaigns.
probes.failure_condition: Unlock storage copies campaign authority or no profile declaration exists.

probes.required_capability: Six observation interfaces coexist with exactly one real M2_TEST_REGION and five interface-only fixtures.
probes.success_condition: Six-observation logic is simulated faithfully without fake full content.
probes.failure_condition: One region counts as six or fixtures enter release content.

probes.required_capability: A package emits an auditable campaign-termination event that freezes the causal chain, removes every action, and cannot be ordinarily rolled back.
probes.probe_type: terminal event and post-threshold authorization integration
probes.success_condition: Accepted termination is immutable through normal controls and audited.
probes.failure_condition: Ordinary undo/continuation remains or all controls cannot be revoked.

probes.required_capability: Player memory claims, world evidence, Agent memory, and authority state are separate stores with explicit one-way projections.
probes.probe_type: schema separation, context construction, leakage, and truth-promotion adversarial checks
probes.success_condition: Only explicit validated evidence changes authority.
probes.failure_condition: A generic save/memory field conflates layers or ordinary AI receives unrelated truth.

probes.required_capability: Namespaced equipment-rule extensions survive manifest validation, host load, Creator import/edit/export, and runtime execution without a privileged format.
probes.probe_type: extension-schema load and lossless Creator round-trip
probes.success_condition: The standard path preserves and executes the extension exactly.
probes.failure_condition: Creator loses semantics or host requires official-game fields.

probes.required_capability: Every safety stage emits fresh evidence, including runtime generation, restore, migration/hot update, asset import, build, and independent acceptance.
probes.success_condition: Every stage rejects independently; stale PASS cannot be reused.
probes.failure_condition: Any stage is missing, warning-only, bypassable, or stale.

probes.required_capability: Logical abnormality is deterministic rules, scopes, priorities, exceptions/collisions, and seeded answers rather than engine nondeterminism.
probes.success_condition: Same seed and log always execute identically and never reroll the answer.
probes.failure_condition: Answer/outcome changes or conflict needs ad hoc narration.
